params.1274: Claim a Ring of Kinship if you have not already.
params.1275: Right-click on the ring and choose 'Open Party Interface'.
params.1276: On the party interface, click 'Form a party' to start a Dungeoneering group.
params.2225: Once you have a party, you can raid floors of the Daemonheim dungeons to earn Dungeoneering experience and tokens.
